page.layout: One page of text, single column; below the text a rule with a small catchword "Cap." at the right; a margin at the right edge holds no legible text.

main_text.p: B. Ita, quod nimirum labes ista originalis, quæ omnibus imputatur, omnibus quoque (per generationem scilicet traducta) inhæret, unde non est aliena modò, sed, quoad speciem, sua cuique personalis & propria, quod ex antedictis abundè constiterit.

p.i: A. De peccato originali satis : nonne altera est species peccati?

main_text.p: B. Est, nimirum actuale, quod est legis divinæ vel minima transgressio actualis.
B. Duplex, vel omissionis, vel commissionis; utrumque rursus cogitati, dicti, facti; quanquam hæc tria peccatum commissionis, magis proprie (quia magis usitato) sonant.

page.notes: The printed page number is "[24]" at the head, with the 4 partly overprinted. The word "Cap." at the lower right is treated as a catchword. Some words near the edges are blurred, notably "Quotuplex" (Q set in a decorative form) and "sonant" which may be "sonant"; no further doubtful readings.
